title: rmcp与官方引擎互操作验证

harness.note: Fixture just contract is valid T02 real-engine evidence for handshake, discovery, resource/prompt reads, error envelopes, and fixture writes. It is not native GUI, Job Object, or real-user-vault evidence.

error_categories.policy: logging/setLevel is denied locally before engine dispatch
error_categories.schema: malformed prompts/get params fail rmcp ClientRequest decode
error_categories.rpc_or_transport: resources/read of memory://bmdock-missing-resource returns MCP -32602 via rmcp
error_categories.unknown_tool: __bmdock_missing_tool__ returns a successful RPC envelope with isError true
error_categories.invalid_tool_arguments: not classified as rpc_or_transport; missing or swapped tool args stay MCP tool isError

AC02.claim: Both immutable profiles completed a real rmcp handshake with negotiated protocolVersion 2025-11-25, paginated tools/resources/templates/prompts discovery, first-resource read, first-prompt get, inputSchema invariants, and distinguishable policy/schema/rpc_or_transport/tool-error envelopes. Suites were invoked separately and reports were not merged.

AC08.claim: Write MCP envelopes are classified accepted_unverified from FastMCP structuredContent.result.action. Disk success is only recorded after wait_note observes the unique sentinel in sandbox/vault Markdown. Policy, schema, rpc_or_transport, tool isError, and unclassified remain distinct. UI copy is not used as persistence proof.
unverified: production vault or Cloud disk state
search index freshness as a success signal

AC16.claim: The probe never retries after TimeoutError, wait_note timeout, policy, schema, rpc_or_transport, or tool errors. Rust timeout_unknown emits 'Result unknown. No retry was performed.' and stops the session. Live lost-response, cancel-after-accept, timeout_unknown injection, forced-kill, and disk-failure remain T03.

AC35.claim: Runtime tool names match each profile baseline independently (release 21, main-preview 27) with empty inventory_delta. search and fetch remain separate names with distinct required fields (query vs id). Swapped identity calls fail with MCP isError. Dedicated search/fetch are not aliased. Desktop-client negative tests remain out of T02.
unverified: in-product tool execution outside the G0 probe allowlist
